name: underline
description: Caption design: keywords stay white and a thick bar in the style's highlight colour slides in under each one as he says it, then holds until the caption ends.
plan: a style setting, not a plan entry: "caption_template": "underline" (optional: underline_thickness_px 12, underline_gap_px 4, underline_slide_ms 120)
example: how to write a caption design: captions.css styles the words, captions.js adds timed animations to tl. Each caption: {el, t0, words: [{el, at, hot, text}]}; times are seconds on the video's timeline.
